pages.title: Rubber Sap
pages.text: Rubber Sap is collected by the $(bold)Tree Tap$(). Place the Tap against the side of any log and wait — it drills in over several cycles and fills up with sap. Use a hopper to collect it automatically.
Smelt Rubber Sap to get Rubber. A Blast Furnace works faster.
Smelt Rubber a second time to get Plastic Sheet — the base material for plastic tools and armour.

pages.title: Plastic Tools
pages.text: Plastic tools are fast and cheap — great for getting started. They have $(bold)100 durability$() and $(bold)8.0 mining speed$(). The downside is they cannot be enchanted. When they break, toss them in the $(bold)Recycler$() to recover a Plastic Sheet.
Same pattern for axe, shovel, and hoe.

pages.title: Plastic Armour
pages.text: Plastic armour gives $(bold)2 / 4 / 6 / 2 defence$() for helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots. Repair it with $(bold)Plastic Sheet$() at an anvil. It is lightweight protection while you work toward hazmat gear or steel.
Same pattern for leggings and boots.
